final: WITH by_equipment AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS overall_avg FROM by_equipment), differences AS (SELECT b.equipref, b.avg_humidity, b.avg_humidity - o.overall_avg AS difference FROM by_equipment AS b CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE b.avg_humidity > o.overall_avg), mean_difference AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS mean_humidity FROM differences) SELECT d.equipref, d.avg_humidity, d.difference, d.avg_humidity - m.mean_humidity AS difference_from_mean FROM differences AS d CROSS JOIN mean_difference AS m ORDER BY difference_from_mean DESC LIMIT 10
